name: Shapeoko 4 Standard (user's)
_note: Values marked verified=false are placeholders until measured / taken from the resurfacer machine capture.

bitzero.plate_thickness_source: paper test on this machine 2026-11-16: probe with 13.0 put Z0 at machine -50.720, paper dragged at work Z -0.260, so 13.0 + 0.26 + ~0.1 paper = 13.36 (calipers 13.1-13.45). Single paper test; ledger B1
bitzero._note: XY corner probing needs bore_diameter and bore_center_to_corner (ledger B3); until measured only Z probing is allowed on the machine

spindle.spin_down_source: assumed: the router was still coasting 1.2 s after M5 on 2026-11-16; not timed (ledger D2a)
spindle.s_threshold_source: measured 2026-11-16 ($30=24000): M3 S10000 does not switch the BitRunner on, M3 S18000 does; the threshold in between is not measured (ledger C7)
spindle._note: resume preamble dwells for the file's own G4 after M3 when present, else spin_up_s (D15, ledger C5)

_rapid_note: the controller allows 10000 mm/min on X/Y ($110/$111, ledger A2), but rapid_mm_min is also the MCP feed cap for Claude's moves, so it stays at 5000
_planner_note: from the controller's $I [OPT:VNPR,14,128] (ledger A4); the bridge uses the live $I value once it has seen one. BitSetter xy measured 2026-11-16 (ledger B6)

bed.source: assumed from published Shapeoko 4 Standard dimensions (working area about 445 x 456 mm, Y rails outside the X travel, front and back extrusions, hybrid spoilboard) laid out around the profile envelope and the measured BitSetter; nothing here is measured. Measure: ledger B11 (spoilboard corners), B12 (frame/rails), B9 (spoilboard Z)
